description: This is a Non motorized trail. The trail will pass through a number of environments, from timbered slopes to alpine meadows to Mara Lookout to an elevation of approx. 2235m. Boardwalks exist over wet area. Great Views of the surrounding area and mountains. On the way up are two shelters. The trail also passes through King Fisher Creek Park.
directions: Trail head location is Lat 50? 49.711'N , Long 118? 50.063'W. The access to the trail head is approx. 16.5 km. The road is very rough requiring high clearance is the Owl Head Forest service Road. It is an active forest road with a radio controlled. The parking area is small along the road r/w.
title: Mara Lookout Trail
